one_sentence: This document argues that the Master Equation (MEQ) is the canonical formalization of Grace (G) as the foundational chi variable in Theophysics.
executive_summary: This document establishes the Master Equation (MEQ) as the canonical formalization of Grace (G), the first of ten chi variables in Theophysics. It argues that Grace is the foundational, unearned, and unconditional ontological gift that grounds all subsequent variables. The key structural claim is that MEQ-G encodes the principle of unmerited favor as a formal, mathematical axiom within the Theophysics framework. The conclusion is that Grace is not merely a theological concept but a necessary, formal first principle for the entire system, enabling the derivation of other variables and laws.
short_summary: This document is the canonical definition of the Master Equation for Grace (MEQ-G). It claims that Grace (G) is the foundational chi variable, representing unearned ontological gift. The key evidence is the formal equation itself, which encodes this principle as an axiom. This matters because it establishes the first principle from which the entire Theophysics framework is derived.
